{{Quote|We'd like to have you meet Bitsy.|[[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]]|<ref name="KE" />}}
'''Bitsy''' was an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was mounted atop the ''[[Moomo Williwaw]]'', a [[Pelagia Duplex Command Assault Gunship]] owned by the [[Moomo Brothers]] at the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> Millennia later in the [[Republic Dark Age]], the cannon was recovered and used by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force [[Rusher's Brigade]].<ref name="KE" /><ref name="Faraway-Star Wars: Knight Errant – Deluge #2">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknighterrantdeluge/swknighterrantdeluge2.html|text=Star Wars: Knight Errant &ndash; Deluge #2}}</ref> The [[Brigade/Legends|Brigade]] deployed the weapon in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], during an attack on the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calimondretta]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]].<ref name="KE" />
